blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Carlo Paalam emerged as the last Filipino boxer fighting for a medal after advancing to the Asian Games 2026 men’s boxing 55-kilogram semifinals with a split-decision win over Jiamao Zhang on Monday at Nishio Gymnasium. Paalam is now assured of at least the bronze medal after prevailing in a tight bout, with three judges scoring it 29-28 in his favor after three rounds.
